Opening for Lifescience and Paramedical Graduates
Production- Trainee
jobs.description:
**Job Responsibilities**

* Operate plant equipment, handle materials, and monitor processes as per the Batch Production Record (BPR) during shift operations.
* Develop skills to physically operate various plant equipment and resolve minor equipment problems.
* Follow and strictly adhere to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) as per Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure accurate and timely recording of required data in BPRs, equipment logs, and cleaning status records.
* Maintain good housekeeping and ensure the safety of personnel, materials, and machinery in the plant as per SOPs.
* Maintain personal hygiene as required under cGMP guidelines.
* Follow all workplace safety norms and procedures without deviation and wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), including goggles, helmets, gloves, full\-face masks, and safety aprons, as required.
* Contain, control, and safely manage spills in the plant, including spill recovery and salvage operations as per established procedures.
* Regularly monitor overall plant parameters, equipment performance, and utilities during shift operations.
* Report any process deviations to the supervisor and promptly update the relevant deviation documentation.
* Perform troubleshooting to identify and resolve plant operational issues.
* Ensure proper receipt, handling, storage, and movement of materials to and from the plant during shift hours.
* Maintain good interpersonal relationships with shop\-floor personnel and other departments.
* Immediately report any abnormality observed during the process or in the plant to the shift in\-charge.
* Support the shift in\-charge in achieving production targets while maintaining quality and safety standards.
* Maintain thorough knowledge of chemicals handled in the plant, including their properties, hazards, and Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS/SDS).
* Communicate the current process status, pending activities, and any abnormalities to the reliever during shift handover.
* Coordinate with Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Control (QC), Electrical and Mechanical Maintenance, Stores, and other relevant departments to meet plant operational requirements.

**Educational Qualifications**

* B.Sc. in Chemistry
* M.Sc. in Chemistry
* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Biochemistry
* B.E. in Chemical Engineering
* B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Customer Support Executive
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Customer Support Executive** 

**About the Company**   
***Kanakkupillai*** **(Govche India Private Limited)** is a Chennai\-based, technology\-driven business consulting and professional services firm. We support startups, SMEs, and growing enterprises by simplifying their legal, financial, and compliance requirements. Our team comprises experienced Chartered Accountants, Company Secretaries, Corporate Lawyers, and Business Advisors who deliver reliable and timely solutions. Our services include business registration and incorporation, GST and Income Tax services, accounting and bookkeeping, payroll management, trademark and intellectual property services, and ongoing statutory and regulatory compliance. With a strong focus on quality, transparency, and customer satisfaction, we help businesses stay compliant and achieve sustainable growth.

**Job Summary**   
We are looking for a Customer Support Executive to manage inbound and outbound customer interactions and ensure timely resolution of queries through calls, emails, and chat support. The role focuses on delivering excellent service to business customers while maintaining high customer satisfaction levels within defined turnaround times (TATs).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle inbound and outbound calls professionally and efficiently
* Resolve customer queries via calls, emails, and chat support
* Ensure customer satisfaction by providing accurate and timely solutions within defined TATs
* Understand business customer requirements and address their concerns effectively
* Maintain proper documentation of customer interactions and resolutions
* Adhere to company processes, quality standards, and communication guidelines
* Escalate unresolved issues to the concerned teams and follow up until closure

**Skills \& Requirements** 

* Good communication skills in English and Tamil
* Strong problem\-solving and customer\-handling skills
* Ability to manage multiple communication channels (calls, emails, and chat)
* Customer\-centric mindset with a focus on service excellence
* Basic computer knowledge; familiarity with CRM systems is preferred
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and meet defined TATs

**Experience** 

* 0–3 years of experience in customer support or a similar role
* Freshers with strong multilingual communication skills are encouraged to apply

Benefits \& Competitive Advantage

* Provident Fund (PF) and ESI coverage
* Medical Insurance
* Paid weekly off
* Attractive performance\-based incentives

How to Apply Interested candidates can share their resume at hinduja@kanakkupillai.com or contact 7305048933\.

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
